problem_text:
A regional sales director must conduct in-person visits to seven branch offices spread across a state.

The travel times between offices, measured in minutes, are as follows:
* Office 1 to Office 2: 64.0 minutes
* Office 1 to Office 3: 182.3 minutes
* Office 1 to Office 4: 181.1 minutes
* Office 1 to Office 5: 44.8 minutes
* Office 1 to Office 6: 106.7 minutes
* Office 1 to Office 7: 78.2 minutes
* Office 2 to Office 3: 210.4 minutes
* Office 2 to Office 4: 173.9 minutes
* Office 2 to Office 5: 103.0 minutes
* Office 2 to Office 6: 145.4 minutes
* Office 2 to Office 7: 66.4 minutes
* Office 3 to Office 4: 106.2 minutes
* Office 3 to Office 5: 147.6 minutes
* Office 3 to Office 6: 77.6 minutes
* Office 3 to Office 7: 148.7 minutes
* Office 4 to Office 5: 169.9 minutes
* Office 4 to Office 6: 122.8 minutes
* Office 4 to Office 7: 110.0 minutes
* Office 5 to Office 6: 70.0 minutes
* Office 5 to Office 7: 88.2 minutes
* Office 6 to Office 7: 95.5 minutes

The objective is to identify the most time-efficient itinerary that allows the director to hold a meeting at each branch exactly once, concluding the tour by returning to the initial office of departure.
